scope: Three style studies, not integrated into the game. Ayi neutral-expression bust, logo, empty table.
preparation: Normalize dimensions and transparent margins. Game Boy pixels quantized to four named colors with binary alpha. Preview composited from finished assets.

assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create one standalone production-quality style study asset for Virtual Taiwan Mahjong Parlor. Style: Taiwanese vintage hand-printed movie poster / shop-sign illustration. Confident coarse dark ink contours, deliberately flattened shapes, limited ink palette of deep jade green, vermilion red, warm ochre, ivory and muted teal blue. Subtle ink trapping and halftone in shadows, tiny paper-grain INSIDE the artwork only. Handcrafted expressive drawing; NOT a modern cel-animation recolor, NOT pixel art, NOT shiny 3D. True transparent RGBA background, no backdrop/checkerboard and no watermark. Reference is the EXACT character identity and pose to preserve: Ayi, a youthful male anime hero with short tousled brown hair and distinctive upward cowlick, large blue eyes, gentle closed-mouth smile, silver shoulder/chest armor, black high-neck undersuit. Maintain same frontal head-and-shoulders bust, gaze, facial proportions, armor design, crop and silhouette. For monochrome style, translate natural colors into the four-green palette while retaining identity. No added accessories, weapon, text, frame, scene, hands or change of costume. Full cowlick, both shoulders visible; small transparent margin on every side. Square 512x512 composition. Make the selected art medium unmistakable.
